title: Why You Feel So Tired After a Big Meal
hook: Why do you always feel sleepy after a big meal?

narration.text: Feeling really tired after a big meal is a common experience.
Your body redirects blood flow to the digestive system.
This means less blood goes to your brain.
Digesting food also uses up a lot of energy.
This combination makes you feel drowsy.
It is your body focusing its resources on digestion.
Like this if it surprised you, subscribe for more fascinating body facts, and tell us in the comments what makes you sleepy.

description: Ever wondered why you feel so sleepy after a large meal? It is not just you, your body is actually redirecting blood flow and energy to help with digestion. This natural process can leave you feeling quite drowsy as your system works hard.
topic: Why you might suddenly feel very tired after a big meal. This is due to blood flow redirection and digestive processes.
